ruleset_status: Forsaken Depths tables (fd_* keys below) validated against Four Against the Forsaken Depths. Live engine: river/boat, traps, treasure, events (flood/earthquake/labyrinth/portal/mist), Lady in Gray quests, Cairn tap, hidden treasure chamber, FD p.55 player hallucination mechanics and mirrored foe effects, FD horde attacks/volleys/Lizardman poison/salvage, Revelation auto-apply, Surrounded by Foes combat-round duration tracking, side sheets, citadel modifiers, Oblivion, ruins secret passage.
open_items: Rulebook validation → validated on all 72 tiles.

any.description: Complex Precursor machinery fills the chamber.
The foreboding atmosphere triggers a hallucination.
Vermin lurk in the forsaken tunnels.
A Forsaken Depths trap is hidden here.
A boss monster from the Forsaken Depths Boss Table is here.
A weird monster prowls this stretch.
The area is empty. You may Search this space.
Roll on the Forsaken Depths Events Table.
A horde gathers in the depths.

fd_river_hazard_table.result: Waste of Time — navigation takes 20 minutes (two rooms). Roll once for Wandering Monsters.
Damaged Boat — the boat is slightly damaged. A second Damaged Boat result destroys the boat; the party must disembark.
Ambush — riverine creatures attack with surprise. Roll on the Forsaken Depths River Encounter Table.
Ghosts of the River — all characters Save vs. HCL Fear (+½L; cleric-save classes +L). Failure: 1 Madness or −2 Life.
Teleport — the boat jumps to another river stretch on the map. The boatman rolls L8 boating (+L) or the boat is Damaged.
Special Feature — this stretch gains a Cairn, Bridge, or Entrance to a Citadel (even if not printed on the tile).

fd_minions_table.name: Deep Trolls
fd_minions_table.summary: 2d6+1 HCL+1 minions; 1 slain troll returns after a troll turn unless blocked; 1 FD treasure roll at -1.

fd_horde_table.name: Horde of Deep Trolls
fd_horde_table.summary: HCL+1 horde, HCL+2 Life, 1 attack per character, regenerates 1 Life at end of turn.

fd_horde_table.name: Horde of Deep Hobgoblins
fd_horde_table.summary: HCL+3 horde, HCL Life, 1 attack per character, morale +1, 2 FD treasure rolls.

fd_horde_table.name: Horde of Chaos Cultists
fd_horde_table.summary: HCL horde, HCL Life, 1 attack per character, never tests Morale, no treasure.

fd_horde_table.name: Horde of Dark Elves
fd_horde_table.summary: HCL+2 horde, 10 Life, opening hand-crossbow volley, 1 attack per character, 1 FD treasure roll.

fd_horde_table.name: Horde of Lizardmen of the Deep
fd_horde_table.summary: HCL+2 horde, HCL Life, 2 attacks per character; app rolls wound-poison save at end of party turns and applies cumulative -1 Attack until Blessing.

fd_horde_table.name: Horde of Goblins of the Deep
fd_horde_table.summary: HCL horde, HCL-1 Life, opening javelin volley, Morale -1, L drops by 2 at half Life.

fd_event_table.name: Lady in Gray
fd_event_table.summary: Offers a Quest — roll on the Forsaken Depths Quest Table (FD p.54).

fd_event_table.name: Winds of Despair
fd_event_table.summary: App prompts each living hero to choose 1 Madness or 2 Life loss before play continues (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: Something Stirs in the Darkness
fd_event_table.summary: For 6 areas, empty rooms have 3-in-6 river encounters (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: Labyrinth Shifts
fd_event_table.summary: Reroll shapes (not content) of the last 5 visited rooms (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: Flood
fd_event_table.summary: Three HCL+2 Swimming Saves per hero; scrolls and bows at risk (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: Earthquake
fd_event_table.summary: Each hero rolls d3 falling stones; each stone is a Save vs. HCL and each failure costs 1 Life (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: Nightmare Mist
fd_event_table.summary: Save vs. HCL+2 hallucinations or roll Hallucinations Table (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: The Portal
fd_event_table.summary: Working portal — choose destination; 1 Life per crossing (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: The Passage
fd_event_table.summary: Secret door to a Citadel — Tier-in-6 corridor trap chance (FD p.63).

fd_event_table.name: Hidden Treasure Chamber
fd_event_table.summary: Three magic items guarded by a Weird Monster +4 Life (FD p.63).

fd_trap_table.result: Magic Resistant Liquid splashes a random hero — app blocks spells, prayers, scroll casts, and magic-item casts for six rooms (FD p.58).
Oblivion Trapdoor — lead hero Saves or falls for 1 damage; app rolls allies' memory Saves and erases hero/equipment if nobody remembers them (FD p.58).
Obsidian Disk — all heroes Save (armor/shield apply) or take Tier+2 damage; app adds d6 brittle masterwork knife pieces as claimable treasure (FD p.58).
Beast Cage — lead hero Saves or app spawns a surprise Weird Monster with no treasure and no Final Boss status (FD p.58).
Soulbinding Trap — rear hero Saves or is bound to this room; app prompts 1 Life loss or 1 Madness for each later area away until Blessing (FD p.58).
Disintegration Blast — random hero Saves or app asks whether to sacrifice a permanent magic item for Tier+1 damage, otherwise the hero is incinerated with no resurrection (FD p.58).

fd_hallucination_table.name: I am Surrounded by Foes
fd_hallucination_table.summary: Victim attacks allies for d3+1 turns (FD p.55).

fd_hallucination_table.name: My Fingers are Worms
fd_hallucination_table.summary: Victim drops held items for one encounter (FD p.55).

fd_hallucination_table.name: There is no Danger Here
fd_hallucination_table.summary: Victim ignores the next danger source (FD p.55).

fd_hallucination_table.name: Horrors from Beyond
fd_hallucination_table.summary: Victim gains Madness equal to Tier (FD p.55).

fd_hallucination_table.name: Revelations
fd_hallucination_table.summary: 1 Madness plus one automatic success benefit (FD p.55).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Complex Machinery
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: App offers one first-visit attempt per living hero: HCL+2 understand roll for 1 Clue or d6 Food rations, or Tier damage on failure (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Servitors
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: Roll Forsaken Depths Minions Table (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Psychic Residue
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: App rolls all HCL+3 psychic Saves, gives successful heroes the +3 future-save marker, and offers failure choices for damage, Madness, or spell slots (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Trap
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: Roll Forsaken Depths Trap Table; 2-in-6 treasure in rooms (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Boss Monster
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: Boss — not Final Boss but counts as Major Foe (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Weird Monster
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: Roll Forsaken Depths Weird Monster Table (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Event
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: Roll Forsaken Depths Events Table (FD p.56).

fd_ruins_content_table.name: Secret Passage
fd_ruins_content_table.summary: Abyss, Netherworld, or Citadel — find with Clues/traps/monsters (FD p.56).

fd_citadel_table.name: Ghost Citadel
fd_citadel_table.summary: 3d6 oversized rooms; entry Madness and HCL+6 hallucination Save; final room Citadel Weird Final Boss (FD p.60).

fd_citadel_table.name: Crowded Citadel
fd_citadel_table.summary: 4d6 rooms; double minion counts; −1 Reaction (FD p.60).

fd_citadel_table.name: Citadel of Traps
fd_citadel_table.summary: 10+2d6 rooms; Minions/Hordes have 4-in-6 trap replacement; trap-guarded rooms have 3-in-6 treasure (FD p.60).

fd_citadel_table.name: Prisoners of the Citadel
fd_citadel_table.summary: 3d6 rooms; gates lock. Spend 4 Clues to reveal the Secret Exit in the next room entered; if all rooms are visited, open it from the first room (FD p.60).

fd_citadel_table.name: Citadel of Dead Things
fd_citadel_table.summary: 2d6+6 rooms; no healing except bandages (FD p.60).

fd_citadel_table.name: Magic Citadel
fd_citadel_table.summary: 3d6 rooms; MR suspended; 1-in-6 idols/altars; final Cyclopean Idol guarded by Weird +1 Life immune to Citadel altar spells (FD p.60).

fd_citadel_weird_table.name: Chaos Mothbeast Queen
fd_citadel_weird_table.summary: HCL+6 chaos weird, HCL+6 Life, 6 attacks (FD p.61).

fd_citadel_weird_table.name: Undead Leviathan
fd_citadel_weird_table.summary: HCL+5 undead weird, HCL+6 Life (FD p.61).

fd_wandering_monsters_table.result: Roll on the Forsaken Depths Vermin Table (FD p.38).
Roll on the Forsaken Depths Minions Table (FD p.40).
Roll on the Forsaken Depths Weird Monsters Table (FD p.45).
Roll on the Forsaken Depths Boss Monsters Table (FD p.44).

fd_treasure_table.result: d6×10 Food points and d6 bottles of fine wine (10 gp each).
Up to 50 gp in common equipment from any equipment Table.
Precious silk worth d20+20 gp (once per adventure; reroll if duplicated).
10d6+10 gp OR a Masterwork weapon of your choice.
d6 Masks of Thar-Tizan (50 gp each; ignore 1 Madness once).
Choose: 10 silvered melee weapons, 5 Legendary magic missiles, or 1 masterwork bow with 24 silver-tipped arrows.
2 potions of healing OR 2 scrolls with random spells.
Scroll with secret information (2 Clues) OR tier-appropriate magic item roll.
Roll twice on this table OR roll four times with 4-in-6 wandering monsters while looting.

fd_quest_table.result: Bring back my escaped servitor — capture with Sleep or non-lethal melee at -1 (FD p.54).
Defeat my enemy — random Weird or Boss after 5 areas or 1 Clue (FD p.54).
Find four lost pages of my tome — treat scroll finds as pages (FD p.54).
Bring three newly found magic items different from gear you held at accept (FD p.54).
Pilgrimage to three Cyclopean Idols — roll fd_cyclopean_idol_table each visit (FD p.54).
Clean out the Dark Pits — d6+3 rooms on fd_ruins_content_table (FD p.54).

fd_heroic_magic_item_table.name: Lucky Boat
fd_heroic_magic_item_table.result: Boat with 3 Boatman's Luck charges; gnome or spellcaster required aboard (FD p.49).

fd_heroic_magic_item_table.name: Repeating Crossbow
fd_heroic_magic_item_table.result: Mechanical repeating crossbow — ranged +1; nat 1 jams (FD p.49).

fd_heroic_magic_item_table.name: Deepbane Stick
fd_heroic_magic_item_table.result: Magic cudgel +4 vs forsaken/deep/depth foes for casters (FD p.49).

fd_heroic_magic_item_table.name: Gauntlets of Shadow and Lightning
fd_heroic_magic_item_table.result: +1 Defense; once/adventure shadow wall or blinding flash (FD p.49).

fd_heroic_magic_item_table.name: d3 Humming Crystals
fd_heroic_magic_item_table.result: Recharge one-use items or save scrolls from destruction (FD p.49).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: Legendary Wizard's Staff
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: +Tier spellcasting; Legendary blunt light weapon (FD p.50).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: Legendary Weapon
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: +Tier Attack; roll d6 for weapon type (FD p.50).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: Legendary Amulet
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: +Tier to all Saves; fails vs MR 15+ (FD p.50).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: Legendary Attire
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: +Tier wooing; not with armor; 1-in-10 dirties after melee (FD p.50).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: d6 Humming Crystals
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: Recharge spent magic items or save scrolls (FD p.50).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: Legendary Healing Cauldron
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: Once/adventure rest — Tier potions of healing (FD p.50).

fd_legendary_magic_item_table.name: Legendary Talisman
fd_legendary_magic_item_table.result: Tier Luck points like halfling Luck (FD p.50).

fd_cyclopean_idol_table.name: Climb for Gems
fd_cyclopean_idol_table.summary: HCL+1 climb; head holds 3-in-6 d3 gems (FD p.52).

fd_cyclopean_idol_table.name: Walking Idol
fd_cyclopean_idol_table.summary: HCL+4 artificial weird, HCL+4 Life — always fights (FD p.52).

fd_cyclopean_idol_table.name: Pedestal Secret Door
fd_cyclopean_idol_table.summary: 1 Clue or Search opens d6+3 FAD side dungeon with ruins loot (FD p.52).

fd_cyclopean_idol_table.name: Life Sap
fd_cyclopean_idol_table.summary: Living heroes lose 1 Life; 1-in-6 Clue per hero damaged (FD p.52).

fd_cyclopean_idol_table.name: Lady in Black
fd_cyclopean_idol_table.summary: Sacrifice Heroic item for 1 Clue and a Quest, or roll fd_quest_table with oracle enchantment (FD p.52).

fd_cyclopean_idol_table.name: Heroic Spell Bas-relief
fd_cyclopean_idol_table.summary: Random Heroic spell etched on pedestal — learn with XP roll (FD p.52).
